title: ruellia blumeana

This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
